frames.caption: The front door: the largest measured improvement, what the engine wants, and what it has done.
One objective, with each benchmark stated at its honest significance rather than a bare delta.
Every candidate the engine has scored, plotted against the incumbent it had to beat.
A night, replayed from the ledger: what was proposed, what was measured, what the boundary decided.
The swarm: which agent each tier routes to and why, and a panel that dispatches real work.
What the engine wants right now, as numbers — including the two drives it cannot measure yet.
The desktop shell, captured from the running window.
How it keeps itself current: two channels, seven safeguards, and both machines it updates.
